bio.text: Ted Lieu represents California's 36th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2014, and is Vice Chair of the House Democratic Caucus.
Before Congress he served in the California State Senate from 2011 to 2014, in the State Assembly from 2005 to 2010, and on the Torrance City Council.
He served in the U.S. Air Force JAG Corps on active duty and then in the Reserve, retiring in 2021 with the rank of Colonel.
His family immigrated to the United States when he was three years old; he studied at Stanford University and received a law degree from Georgetown University.
